baseline_models.mechanism: Covering the creator-creature relation enables the addressees to assign peer-status to what is not a peer.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the obscuring action that makes the following reassignment possible.
Blocking a manifest truth specifies what the covering does epistemically.
Assigning a thing a condition or rank makes rivalhood an imposed status.
A counterpart similar in one respect yet opposed in another supplies the fabricated peer relation.

changed_reading.before: Do you disbelieve in the creator and set up rivals?
changed_reading.after: Do you cover the evident creator relation and then manufacture peer-status for created things?

baseline_models.mechanism: Creation is measured formation of productive ground across temporal stages under continuing nurture, not only a punctual beginning.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring and proportioning gives creation a fitted, deliberate structure.
Soft productive ground makes the created object a potential habitat rather than inert mass.
A duration rather than only a daylight unit permits staged formation.
Progressive repair, upbringing, and completion extend the act into sustained care.

changed_reading.before: He created the earth in two days.
changed_reading.after: He measured out a productive ground through two temporal stages as the opening of sustained formation.

baseline_models.mechanism: Lordship governs and completes domains that bear distinguishing marks by which their source is knowable.

activation_trace.role: Ownership and governing authority supply the scope of lordship.
Care toward completion makes governance developmental.
A distinguishing trace that guides toward its bearer activates worlds as marked, legible domains.

changed_reading.before: That is the Lord of all worlds.
changed_reading.after: That is the governing cultivator of sign-bearing domains whose marks lead beyond themselves.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah frames both discourse and creation as differentiated marks: detailed textual signs train recognition, then horizon and self signs become manifest and testify.

activation_trace.role: The focus branch supplies the mark that identifies and guides toward what lies beyond it.
Detailing that exposes parts and meanings supplies differentiated textual legibility.
The visible sign gives the text the same indicative function later carried by creation.
Far horizons expand the sign-field to the world's outer reaches.
Emergence into clarity supplies the transition from present mark to recognized truth.
A witnessing mark makes the world's evidence active rather than decorative.

structural_cues: The opening details signs for a knowing people; the ending promises signs in horizons and selves until the truth becomes clear.
The focus earth stands between these textual and cosmic disclosure frames.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: detailed textual signs and horizon/self signs become clear and witness. Reader: the focus al-alamin mark-branch makes worlds readable domains. Alternative: al-alamin may retain only its ordinary collective scope.

changed_reading.before: Lord of a generic totality of worlds.
changed_reading.after: Lord of differentiated, readable domains whose marks disclose their maker and keeper.

context_deltas.mechanism: Disbelief becomes a practiced occlusion stack: protected inner covers, weighted hearing, an interpersonal barrier, preferred blindness, and deliberate acoustic interference.

activation_trace.role: Covering supplies the focus action that the context distributes across several channels.
A protective cover locates occlusion inside the heart's claimed enclosure.
Weight in the ear blocks the auditory route into understanding.
Prevention of access turns separation from the messenger into an enacted barrier.
Intense preference supplies agency: blindness is selected, not merely suffered.
Blindness of insight shifts the blockage from missing data to disabled recognition.
Hearing as understanding and compliance identifies what the prohibition tries to prevent.
Mixed noise supplies an active technique for covering a recited sign.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from claimed inner and interpersonal barriers to chosen blindness and coordinated noise.
At 41:44 the ear-weight and blindness recur after the Quran is named guidance and healing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: covers, ear-weight, barrier, preferred blindness, and noise all obstruct reception. Reader: these are concrete enactments of the focus covering branch. Alternative: kufr still denotes doctrinal rejection without requiring every listed technique.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief is an abstract negative judgment about the creator.
changed_reading.after: Disbelief is sustained by building, choosing, and policing the perceptual barriers that keep the creator relation from becoming legible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earth's two-stage making opens a larger fitted system: anchoring, stable increase, calibrated sustenance, willing response, differentiated completion, assigned functions, and protection.

activation_trace.role: Measured formation supplies the focus operation expanded by the following sequence.
Fixity and rootedness give the habitat structural stability.
Stable, growing good gives formation a fecund direction.
Deliberate planning turns provisions into fitted allocation rather than accidental supply.
Life-sustaining provision identifies the functional goal of the earth's fitting.
Compliance supplies a responsive relation between command and cosmos.
Perfecting workmanship and carrying action through supplies completion of differentiated heavens.
Each heaven's affair gives every differentiated region a fitted function.
Guarding adds preservation to formation and provision.

structural_cues: 41:9-12 proceeds from earth in two days, through its stabilization and provisions, to cosmic summons and differentiated heavens.
The repeated two-day span for earth and heavens frames coordinated stages without itself deciding how the four days relate arithmetically.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: ordered stages of making, provision, summons, completion, function, and protection. Reader: these form one habitat-building mechanism under rabb-care. Alternative: the lines may be read chiefly as chronology rather than functional assembly.

changed_reading.before: The two days merely date the earth's origination.
changed_reading.after: The two days name the first measured phase of a provisioned, responsive, differentiated, and preserved habitat.

context_deltas.mechanism: A people elevate their own accumulated strength into a comparison class with the creator, even though their createdness already defeats the comparison.

activation_trace.role: The opposed counterpart supplies the focus category into which human power is promoted.
Self-magnification supplies the upward status movement.
Strength gathered like strands supplies the metric used in the false comparison and its rebuttal.
Seeing with eye and insight marks the evidence they fail to use.
Their own origination by another breaks the symmetry their strength claim constructs.
Denial despite knowledge connects the false comparison back to willful covering.

structural_cues: The claim 'who is stronger than us?' is immediately answered by 'the one who created them is stronger.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: self-magnification, a strength comparison, createdness, and knowing denial. Reader: collective power can function as an andad even without a named idol. Alternative: the focus rivals may refer more narrowly to cultic partners.

changed_reading.before: The rivals are external objects of cult.
changed_reading.after: A community can make its own power a rival by treating created strength as a peer metric against its creator.

context_deltas.mechanism: Attached companions beautify the whole perceptual field and induce misdirection; the misled later reverse that status by placing those guides beneath their feet.

activation_trace.role: Assigning a rank supplies the focus mechanism of socially placing a rival.
Counterpart-status names the relation produced by that placement.
A companion bound to another supplies the social carrier of the altered reading.
Making something appear good supplies the perceptual engineering by which false status becomes attractive.
Deviation from the path identifies the companions' functional result.
The repeated assigning verb explicitly reverses the misleaders' former placement.
Placement underneath supplies the spatial demotion.
Low rank completes the reversal from persuasive companion to debased misleader.

structural_cues: Companions beautify what is before and behind, enclosing perception; the sufferers later ask to see and reposition those same kinds of misleaders.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: attached companions beautify, mislead, and are later assigned beneath the feet. Reader: rival-status is socially produced and can be spatially reversed. Alternative: companions and focus rivals need not denote the same agents.

changed_reading.before: Rivals are static entities already standing beside God.
changed_reading.after: Rivalhood is a manufactured social rank, stabilized by persuasive companions and exposed when that rank is reversed.

context_deltas.mechanism: Sun and moon are explicitly classified as created signs, yet prostration can misroute attention from what signifies to the one signified.

activation_trace.role: The opposed peer supplies the erroneous status assigned to a cosmic sign.
A visible marker classifies the cosmic bodies as indicators rather than endpoints.
The actual sun supplies a conspicuous created sign liable to promotion.
The actual moon supplies the paired created sign liable to promotion.
Abasement marks the allegiance that must be redirected from sign to creator.
Createdness supplies the asymmetry that forbids sign and maker from sharing recipient-status.
Submissive worship names the relation whose destination determines whether a sign becomes a rival.

structural_cues: The prohibition and replacement are parallel: do not prostrate to sun or moon; prostrate to God who created them.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: sun and moon are signs, created, and possible recipients of prostration. Reader: making an andad is a category error that converts an indicator into worship's endpoint. Alternative: other kinds of rivals remain in view.

changed_reading.after: Rival-making arrests a created sign at itself and assigns it the recipient-status that belongs to its creator.

context_deltas.mechanism: The created earth is built for recurrent response: lowered and dormant, it receives water, moves, swells, and lives. Rabb-care is therefore visible as continuing activation of created capacities.

activation_trace.role: Productive ground supplies the latent capacity named in the focus.
Progressive cultivation gives the repeated earth-process its governing relation.
The same productive-earth branch carries the focus object into its later enacted state.
Low dormant ground supplies the initial latent condition.
Delivered water supplies the activating input.
Earth and plant stirring with life supplies the first visible response.
Growth by nourishment supplies expansion toward life.
Earth-life through rain and vegetation names the completed responsive cycle.

structural_cues: The visible sequence is dormant earth, descending water, movement, swelling, and revivification.
The verse uses this ecological process as evidence for reviving the dead without erasing its earth-level mechanism.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: earth visibly responds to water by movement, growth, and life. Reader: initial creation includes capacities repeatedly actualized under rabb-care. Alternative: the passage's dominant use may remain resurrection analogy.

changed_reading.before: The creator finished the earth as a past object.
changed_reading.after: The creator formed a responsive life-system whose dormant capacities are repeatedly cultivated into visibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Received mercy is verbally appropriated as 'mine,' then blessing produces a bodily turning-away; covering the giver occurs by enclosing the gift within self-ownership.

activation_trace.role: Covering a benefit and withholding gratitude supplies the focus mechanism.
Merciful tenderness identifies what is received before it is appropriated.
Speech as creed turns 'this is mine' into an ownership doctrine, not a passing sound.
The repeated ingratitude branch ties appropriation back to the named response.
Good condition and benefit supply the gift whose source is obscured.
Turning one's side makes ingratitude spatial and embodied.
Withdrawal by the side completes the movement away from the giver.

structural_cues: After mercy following harm, the human says 'this is mine'; after blessing, the human turns aside and withdraws.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: mercy and blessing are followed by possession speech and embodied withdrawal. Reader: self-appropriation covers the giver and can seed rival-status in the self. Alternative: the focus kufr may emphasize explicit theological denial more than ingratitude.

changed_reading.before: Disbelief in the earth's creator is mainly a false proposition.
changed_reading.after: It also occurs when the created habitat and its benefits are sealed into 'mine,' hiding gift, giver, and obligation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the fruit-sheath branch of kufr is far from the focus verb's primary theological use. It remains anchored by that explicit focus branch and by 41:47's fruit emerging from sheaths alongside gestation. Render only as an image-level analogy: a cover can protect a stage, but disbelief behaves like a sheath made final, preventing emergence into sign and gratitude.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: takfuruna, through the focus inventory's fruit-sheath branch

activation_trace.role: The fruit sheath supplies a concrete covering that can be either transitional or arrested.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the release that an arrested cover blocks.
Ripe fruit supplies the disclosed outcome latent inside its cover.
The plant's enclosing sheath directly echoes the focus branch image.
Hidden gestation broadens the image from enclosure to development awaiting disclosure.
Birth supplies the completion of a covering that properly yields what it held.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, disbelief is a transitional cover made terminal: it encloses evidence but refuses the emergence by which hidden provision becomes visible fruit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a structural, spatial inference rather than a new lexical gloss. It remains anchored in andad as an opposed counterpart and rabb al-alamin, while the surah closes with complete encompassing of every thing. Render as topology: a purported co-sovereign remains an internal, encompassed item and cannot occupy an exterior peer position.

activation_trace.role: An opposed counterpart supplies the claimed peer position.
Universal ownership and rule supply the domain within which the claim is tested.
Totality and completion prevent an uncounted outside remainder.
Every knowable, reportable thing supplies the contents of the encompassed domain.
Complete encompassing in knowledge and seizure closes the domain around every proposed peer.

changed_reading.before: A rival is imagined beside God on the same plane.
changed_reading.after: Every proposed rival is already inside the all-encompassing domain it is falsely promoted to co-govern.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because 41:34 concerns human enmity, not divine rivals. It remains anchored in the focus pairing of making and opposed counterpart: the surah demonstrates that an adversarial relation can be transformed into intimate alliance by action. Do not imply that theological rivals become legitimate; use it only to sharpen taj'aluna as active relational production.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: taj'aluna ... andadan as assigning an opposed relation

activation_trace.role: Assigning a condition supplies the possibility that relational status is made rather than intrinsic.
The similar-yet-opposed counterpart supplies the focus relation under examination.
Repelling harm supplies the action that changes the relation.
Doing the good supplies the transformative mode rather than reciprocal hostility.
Enmity supplies the initial opposed status.
Affectionate alliance supplies the relation produced after reversal.

changed_reading.before: An opposed counterpart is simply found as such.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the surah's transformable enmity makes the focus verb audible: opposed peer-status is something agents actively produce and sustain.

strongest_changes: Kufr moved from abstract denial to practiced occlusion across heart, hearing, social distance, choice, and noise.
The earth's two-day creation became the opening phase of a measured, provisioned, responsive, and preserved habitat.
Andad became an assigned status: self-power, companions, and cosmic signs can be promoted into false peerhood.
Al-alamin became legible, differentiated domains whose marks disclose their maker and keeper.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet repeatedly concretized the focus mechanisms: covers and noise enacted kufr, 41:10-12 unfolded creation into habitat assembly, 41:37 showed a sign becoming a worship endpoint, 41:39 reactivated the earth, and 41:53-54 closed with disclosure and encompassing.
remaining_uncertainties: The sequence supports coordinated stages but does not by itself settle the arithmetic relation among the two-day and four-day spans.
The marked-worlds reading is branch-grounded but remains more form-distant than the ordinary collective sense of al-alamin.
The fruit-sheath and transformable-opposition readings are deliberately exploratory analogies, not replacement glosses.
